scenarios.name: Identify a quick access command from its icon and tooltip

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon
the New shortcut is visible on the quick access toolbar
it has a distinct command icon without a persistent text caption
the user hovers over the New icon until its tooltip appears
the tooltip identifies the command as New
the part remains active without a command dialog
the user moves the pointer to an empty area of the viewport
the tooltip disappears
